item.text:
I found a mixed but mostly positive 2024 pattern for 8B.9: Lula generally used institutions, elections, and diplomacy to contain crises and preserve governing capacity, but he also showed real limits in economic-institution management and some inflammatory foreign-policy rhetoric.

**Accepted claims**
- **Brazil marks anniversary of Jan. 8 attack on democracy** | **Reuters via Investing.com** | **2024-01-08** | https://www.investing.com/news/world-news/brazil-to-mark-anniversary-of-january-8-attack-on-democracy-3269163  
  Lula treated the Jan. 8 coup attempt as a real regime-threatening crisis and backed punishment of the perpetrators rather than retaliation or denial. This is strong evidence of crisis management that protected constitutional order and regime durability.  
  **QIDs:** 8B.9

- **Dólar volta a cair após Lula dar trégua ao BC e termina abaixo de R$5,50** | **Reuters via UOL** | **2024-07-04** | https://economia.uol.com.br/noticias/reuters/2024/07/04/dolar-volta-a-cair-apos-lula-dar-tregua-ao-bc-e-termina-abaixo-de-r550.htm  
  After weeks of attacking the Central Bank, Lula paused the pressure and publicly defended fiscal adjustment, which helped calm markets. This is evidence that he could partially repair institutional conflict when the costs became visible.  
  **QIDs:** 8B.9

- **Lula diz que não aceita vitória de Maduro sem provas** | **Reuters via UOL** | **2024-08-30** | https://economia.uol.com.br/noticias/reuters/2024/08/30/lula-reafirma-que-nao-aceita-vitoria-de-maduro-sem-provas.htm  
  Lula refused to endorse Venezuela’s claimed election result without proof and backed publication of vote records, possible new elections, and an international-observer-style mechanism. This supports a reading of managing regional political conflict through procedural legitimacy rather than factional loyalty.  
  **QIDs:** 8B.9

- **Lula at UN touts Brazil-China plan for Ukraine-Russia talks** | **Reuters via Investing.com** | **2024-09-24** | https://www.investing.com/news/world-news/lula-at-un-says-brazil-china-propose-plan-for-ukrainerussia-talks-3630110  
  Lula pushed a peace-track for Ukraine and later kept the initiative alive despite criticism. That is evidence of influence-seeking diplomacy and crisis mediation, even if the plan was controversial.  
  **QIDs:** 8B.9

- **Partidos de centro e da direita consolidam vitória no 2º turno das eleições municipais** | **Reuters via UOL** | **2024-10-27** | https://noticias.uol.com.br/ultimas-noticias/reuters/2024/10/27/partidos-de-centro-e-da-direita-consolidam-vitoria-no-2-turno-das-eleicoes-municipais.amp.htm  
  Lula’s camp suffered electoral losses in major municipal contests, and the reporting shows no retaliation or refusal to accept the result. This is concrete evidence that opposition victories remained real and tolerated in 2024.  
  **QIDs:** 8B.9

- **Lula repete que governo israelense comete genocídio em Gaza e defende criação de Estado palestino** | **Reuters via UOL** | **2024-02-23** | https://noticias.uol.com.br/ultimas-noticias/reuters/2024/02/23/lula-repete-que-governo-israelense-comete-genocidio-em-gaza-e-defende-criacao-de-estado-palestino.htm  
  Lula doubled down on a highly inflammatory accusation after a diplomatic rupture with Israel. This is the clearest negative item for 8B.9 because it shows rhetoric that worsened relations rather than preserving them, even though it was still framed as anti-war and pro–two-state diplomacy.  
  **QIDs:** 8B.9

- **The government pressure around Petrobras dividends and the later minister indictment** | **Reuters via UOL** | **2024-03-18 / 2024-03-20 / 2024-06-12 / 2024-06-13** | https://economia.uol.com.br/noticias/reuters/2024/03/18/ministerio-publico-do-tcu-pede-investigacao-de-possivel-interferencia-do-governo-na-petrobras.htm and https://economia.uol.com.br/noticias/reuters/2024/03/20/fazenda-insiste-com-lula-por-aval-a-dividendo-extra-da-petrobras.amp.htm and https://noticias.uol.com.br/ultimas-noticias/reuters/2024/06/12/ministro-das-comunicacoes-e-indiciado-pela-pf-por-corrupcao-em-investigacao-sobre-desvio-na-codevasf-dizem-fontes.htm and https://noticias.uol.com.br/ultimas-noticias/reuters/2024/06/13/lula-diz-que-tomara-decisao-sobre-juscelino-filho-e-que-indiciamento-nao-significa-que-ministro-cometeu-erro.amp.htm  
  Reuters reported pressure on Lula over Petrobras dividend decisions, and later reported that a cabinet minister indicted in a public-works probe was not immediately removed. These are the strongest caveats that Lula sometimes leaned into discretionary steering and coalition protection rather than clean institutional insulation.  
  **QIDs:** 8B.9

**Synthesis**
- Best-supported positive reading: Lula handled major domestic and international crises in ways that usually favored constitutional continuity, diplomatic off-ramps, and institutional legitimacy.
- Best-supported negative reading: he sometimes undercut that pattern with aggressive rhetoric toward foreign counterparts and with visible pressure on autonomous economic / anti-corruption institutions.
- Net: **moderately positive on 8B.9, with real but bounded caveats**.

**Search gap**
- I did not find a 2024 source showing Lula directly suppressing opposition parties or refusing electoral turnover. The main negatives were instead institutional pressure in the economic sphere and combative diplomacy.
